paper_citation: Enkuan Zhang, Ying Tang, Mingwen Wen, Abdulmonem Obaied, Irina Roslyakova, Lijun Zhang, On phase stability of Mo-Nb-Ta-W refractory high entropy alloys, International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials 103, 105780 (2022).
quote: Among these five equimolar binary alloys, the MoTa alloy has the largest ordering transition temperature, which was calculated to be 1239 K, followed by the MoNb alloy at 682 K and the TaW alloy at 573 K.
